KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Intro.1: Blimey, I seen a lot of hoomans, but ain't you a big 'un?
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Intro.2: Name is Slopfinger. I work for Manktongue ova there. I'm his cook, assistant, butler, mass-ooze and hype-goblin.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Intro.3: Not that he notices me. Yesterday I was crackin' 'is back an' he called me Sweatmonger. Sweatmonger!
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Intro.4: If only I could think of a way to get Manktongue to remember my name...
KeysToEntries.Player.Choice.1: Why not bake him a cake with your name on it?
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Intro.5: You know what, I utterly forgot that I'm a cook! Yer a genie-ooze.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Intro.6: You shall be the assistant's assistant. We will need 4 eggs, 6 lots of wheat and a bucket of milk.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Intro.7: If you need any 'elp wiv finding any of it, ya know where I am.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.GotItems.1: I can tell from the way you're walkin' that you've got bakery stuffs for me.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.GotItems.2: It's a talent. It can't be taught.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.GotItems.3: Next step is to make the cake. You look like ya know yer way 'round a stove. Why don't you have a go?
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.GotItems.4: Goodness no! My hands are all wobbly at the thought of Manktongue learnin' ma name.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.GotCake.1: That cake is ace. Truly ace.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.GotCake.2: Now, don't look for a moment. I need to apply my sig-nah-ture.
KeysToEntries.Player.Choice.3: Did you just write your name in spit?
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.GotCake.3: The spit will show up well on da frostin'. Now hurry, give the cake to Manktongue.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.GotCake.4: I'll be back here with my heart fully in ma mouth.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.GotCake.Return.1: Go give da cake to Manktongue.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.QuestComplete.1: I saw the cake go in his lughole! What did he say?
KeysToEntries.Player.Choice.4: He said, and I quote: "tell Slopfinger he's earned himself a raise".
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.QuestComplete.2: What a ruddy charmer! He even remembered ma name!
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.QuestComplete.3: I feel a growin' pride in the work I do. I cannot fank you enough.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.QuestComplete.4: It ain't much, but I want ya to 'ave this. Perhaps, one day, you will find a boss as good as Manktongue.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.QuestComplete.NoSpace.1: 'Cept you haven't got any room in your bag, 'ave ya? Come back later so I can give you a gift or two.
KeysToEntries.Cow.Intro.1: The Dairy Cow gives you the side-eye.
KeysToEntries.Cow.NoQuest.1: The cow looks supremely confident within its own body. It's to be admired, really.
KeysToEntries.Cow.Milk.Denied.1: The Dairy Cow gives you a kick to the shins.
KeysToEntries.Cow.Pet.1: It's smooth, like a wide, hornless unicorn.
KeysToEntries.Cow.Wheat.1: The cow turns its head expectedly.
KeysToEntries.Player.NoWheat.1: You have no wheat to feed the cow.
KeysToEntries.Cow.Wheat.2: The Dairy Cow chews the wheat without once taking its eyes off you.
KeysToEntries.Cow.Compliment.1: The cow rolls its eyes but blushes a little.
KeysToEntries.Cow.ChoiceComplete.1: The Dairy Cow permits you to milk her.
KeysToEntries.Cow.ChoiceComplete.NoItem.1: The Dairy Cow notes that you have no inventory space and rolls her eyes. You will need to come back when you have room for a bucket of milk.
KeysToEntries.Player.NoIngredients.1: Slopfinger said that I need 4 eggs, 6 wheat and a bucket of milk to bake the cake.
KeysToEntries.Player.Stove.GotItems.1: Do you want to put the ingredients inside the stove?
KeysToEntries.Player.Stove.2: You close your eyes,  jumble the ingredients together, and place them in the stove. Surely this won't work.
KeysToEntries.Player.Stove.4: You step back from the stove.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Choice.Intro.1: Need any help with da stuff?
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Eggs.1: Chicken or terrorbird eggs will do. We don't need to get too fancy.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Eggs.2: I'll want four of da blighters, so that the cake will rise as high as my blood pressure.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Wheat.1: It's not my for-tay, but I believe it involves farmin'.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Wheat.2: Find some wheat seeds and a farmin' patch, and do whatever it is that farmers do. Remember, we need 6 lots of wheat.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Wheat.3: You won't need to make flour or anythin'. I like my cakes to look like sad bread.
KeysToEntries.Player.Ingredients.Choice.Milk.1: Ask about a bucket of milk
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Milk.1: You'll need to milk a Dairy Cow. I don't advise milkin' anything else.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Milk.2: Findin' a dairy cow is the problem. Not so many of them round Ghornfell.
KeysToEntries.Player.Ingredients.Choice.Milk.2: Isn't that a Dairy Cow over there?
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Milk.3: Is it? Blimey - I thought it were a bear.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Milk.4: I've been trying not to maintain eye contact. Been on edge this whole conversation.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.NoHelp.1: We all need help. But you work that out for yoursel'.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.CakeDelivered.1: You given Slopfinger da news about da raise?
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.CakeDelivered.2: Hop to it! Fortune waits for no gobber.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.NoCake.1: Oi oi! You got somethin' for ol' Manktongue?
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.NoCake.2: Da cake is a lie! Hehe.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.NoCake.3: Well, come back over when you've made a new 'un.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.GotCake.1: Oi oi, what do we have 'ere?
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.GotCake.2: Wait, wot's written on da cake? Does that say Slopfinger? Da goblin over there by the cow?
KeysToEntries.Player.MadeCake.1: It's a cake, made for you by Slopfinger
KeysToEntries.Player.ObserveManktongue.1: Manktongue pushes some cake into his ear, where it nestles next to the pie.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.GotCake.4: Ooh, the icin' is drip-droppin' on ma eardrum.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.GotCake.5: Tell 'Slopfinger he's earned himself a raise.
KeysToEntries.QuestDesc: Help Slopfinger in Ghornfell bake a memorable cake for Manktongue.
KeysToEntries.QuestObjective.1: Gather 4 eggs, 6 wheat and a bucket of milk, and bring them all to Slopfinger.
KeysToEntries.QuestObjective.2: Bake a cake using the stove next to Slopfinger.
KeysToEntries.QuestObjective.3: Bring the signed cake to Manktongue.
KeysToEntries.QuestObjective.4: Show Slopfinger the freshly cooked cake.
KeysToEntries.Cake.Desc: A cake requested by Slopfinger, made by you, and intended for Manktongue.
KeysToEntries.Milk.Desc: A bucket of milk from a stubborn cow.
KeysToEntries.Slopfinger.Name: Slopfinger
KeysToEntries.Player.Choice.HadCakeLostIt: I had a cake, but I lost it.
